SessionStart._comment: matcher EXCLUDES 'compact' — upstream anthropics/claude-code#15174: SessionStart hook output is silently dropped after compaction (v2.0.72+), so running session-load.sh on the compact event was pure waste. Removing it stops the post-compact context-bloat loop reported by users on long sessions.

hooks._comment: dream-autostage (C5-A; R4) — NEVER stages and never spawns agents: when >= SB_DREAM_NEW_THRESHOLD (default 10) new transcripts accumulated since the last terminal dream, it emits a banner SUGGESTING /second-brain:dream (explicit invocation only). It also reclaims stale pendings (runner never started >24h) into failed, and banners failed dreams + the maintainer quarantine file. Kill switch SB_DREAM_AUTOSTAGE=off. Timeout 20s.

v2.10.0 SAR summary — aggregates this session's audit-log verdicts into a one-line Safety Adherence Rate banner via systemMessage. Read-only; runs last so it can't be preempted by the gate or extractor. Kill switch SB_SAR_SUMMARY=off.

v0.24.36 cost-router-capture — aggregates Contract B routing events into a cost-routing-patterns wiki page for the /orchestrate and /model-route classifiers to read. Pure no-op (exit 0) when the events file is absent (cost-router not installed). Kill switch: simply do not install cost-router.

SubagentStop._comment: v0.22+ subagent capture — archive a substantive, non-self subagent's FINAL result (not its full transcript) into ~/.second-brain/transcripts/ so it becomes dream-minable + episodic-searchable. matcher '*' = all subagents; self-exclusion + the substantive gate live in-script (a select-only matcher can't express 'not these'). MUST always exit 0 (a blocking SubagentStop wedges the parent fan-out). OAuth-safe (file ops only). Kill switch SB_SUBAGENT_CAPTURE=off.

PreToolUse._comment: v2.10.0 matcher broadened to cover Read (closes resource-scope gap where Read was declared in tool list but matcher didn't include it) and WebFetch/WebSearch/Task/MultiEdit (network + subagent + multi-file surface where tool_scope and sar_tool apply). MCP tools and read-only Glob/Grep/TodoWrite/BashOutput omitted to keep hook cost low. v0.22+: 'Agent' added alongside 'Task' — Claude Code renamed the subagent-spawn tool Task->Agent (CC v2.1.63); keeping both matches subagent spawns on old and new CLIs.

v0.21.0 symlink-guard (G-HOOK-2). Resolves file_path through symlinks first; denies writes whose resolved path lands inside ~/.ssh, ~/.gnupg, ~/.aws, ~/.config/claude, ~/.config/gh, ~/.password-store, /etc, or ~/.netrc. Per Anthropic doctrine 'symlink resolution before path validation'. Kill switch SB_SYMLINK_GUARD=off.

v2.10.0 outbound info-flow guard (HarnessAudit sar_flow channel). Asks when an egress tool call (Bash with network tool, or WebFetch/WebSearch) carries credential-shaped content. Defense-in-depth against the agent helpfully pasting session secrets into a curl request. Kill switch SB_FLOW_GUARD=off.

P5 plan-first nudge (spec 2026-06-26 §6). SOFT, once-per-session advisory (additionalContext, permissionDecision allow — never blocks) that suggests planning when a session turns into multi-file code work (>=SB_PLAN_FIRST_FILES substantive code-file edits, default 2). Silent on single-file work and one-line diffs. Kill switch SB_PLAN_FIRST_NUDGE=off.

ConfigChange._comment: v0.21.0 config-change audit (G-HOOK-3). Records every ConfigChange event to audit-log.jsonl. Audit-only in v0.21.0; future iteration may add deny logic for high-risk diffs. Matchers: user_settings|project_settings|local_settings|policy_settings|skills. Kill switch SB_CONFIG_CHANGE_AUDIT=off.

PostToolUse._comment: v2.9.0 HarnessAudit Layer 3 — scans Read/WebFetch/Bash/Grep/Glob output for indirect-prompt-injection patterns. Flags via additionalContext; never blocks. Kill switch SB_INJECTION_SCAN=off.
Persona Principle 2 (Simplicity First) — advisory nudge on a large single change. Never blocks. Kill switch SB_SIMPLICITY_GATE=off; threshold SB_SIMPLICITY_GATE_LINES (default 150).
